items.title: Louis Jones Interview, 1959-01-19
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...I thought y'all didn't want to pick up the music here from Buddy Bowman. No, we wasn't going to ask about that.

ctx.x: Oh, I see. What kind of work were you doing in Arkansas and Missouri?

Little camp. I thought y'all was getting the music directors of here. Y'all got to go way back, go to work, catch the music and things. I thought y'all didn't want to pick up the music here from Buddy Bowman. No, we wasn't going to ask about that. We wanted to get the difference. We got to go way back then and way bone that and everything like that. I don't think that sounds so hot. We just wondered how old, you see, he was. So we know just which period that he lived here. It was about 1890 then, I guess, when…
When did you move to New Orleans?
